```{r library}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
```

```{r data}
mc <- readRDS(file = 'data-raw/output/monte_carlo.rds')
head(mc)
```

```{r}
truth <- mc[mc$method == 'Truth', c("seed", "cutoff", "estimate")]
names(truth)[3] <- 'truth'
pdat <- merge(mc[mc$method != 'Truth', ], truth)
pdat$error <- pdat$estimate - pdat$truth

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = pdat,
    mapping = aes(
      x = factor(
        method,
        levels = c('Pre/post', 'ITS', 'CITS', 'DiD', 'P+G')
      ),
      y = error
    ),
    outliers = F
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 'dashed',
    color = 'firebrick'
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    transform = pseudo_log_trans(
      sigma = 1,
      base = 10
    ),
    breaks = c(-100, -10, 0, 10, 100)
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    cutoff ~ .,
    labeller = as_labeller(c(`2` = '3', `11` = '12', `35` = '36'))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = 'Estimation Error',
    subtitle = '1000 Resamples',
    x = 'Method',
    y = 'Estimate - Truth (Pseudo-log scale)'
  )
p
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  'data-raw/output/boxplot.png',
  plot = p,
  width = 1600,
  height = 900,
  units = 'px'
)
```
